messages:
viv: Hey team, first-day hiccup. I accepted the org invite and enabled 2FA, but when I try `gh repo clone redwood-inference/quickstart` I get a 403 and the UI says SSO + 2FA required. I thought I did everything.

it-bot: Org policy requires SAML SSO + 2FA. If you recently enabled 2FA, authorize the org: https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso :robot_face: 

viv: I clicked authorize but still 403. I also tried with a personal token I had and that failed. Maybe tokens are blocked by SSO?

infra: welcome @viv! org SSO can block personal tokens from accessing org repos. Use your work account, enable 2FA, click Authorize while signed into the work account, and avoid personal PATs. Can you run `gh auth status` and `ssh -T git@github.com` and paste outputs?

emma: quick tip: if you use the GH desktop app or a PAT generated before SSO was enforced, GH may reject it. Use `gh auth login` to refresh.

viv: `gh auth status` shows:
```
github.com: Logged in to github.com as viv.dev (Work account)
Git operations for github.com: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart (permission: none)
```

viv: `ssh -T` -> Hi viv-dev! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.

infra: SSH key is fine. I just forced a membership sync and added your account to `onboarding`. Sign out of browser, sign back in as viv.dev, then re-click the SSO authorize banner. Also run `gh auth refresh -h github.com` to refresh CLI tokens.

viv: did that and retried clone -> success. `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/quickstart.git` worked. Thanks!

docs: leaving a note in the onboarding doc: avoid using old PATs, prefer `gh auth login`, and use separate browser profile for work vs personal accounts to avoid accepting invites on the wrong account.

emma: one-line checklist for new hires we recommend: verify work email, enable 2FA, add SSH key, sign out/in, click org SSO authorize, run `gh auth login`/`gh auth refresh`, wait ~30s for sync. Ping #new-hires if stuck. :thumbsup:

viv: saved, super helpful. excited to start the quickstart :tada:
